t: AI Safety and Security: Intrusion Detector — Simple
name: AI Safety and Security: Intrusion Detector — Simple
title: AI Safety and Security: Intrusion Detector — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] A detector that watches for the wrong in network traffic: it baselines normal behavior per host, flags deviations with evidence, and scores every alert with a false-positive estimate. Alerts without evidence are noise with a badge.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Detector audit at 95%, p=0.05 = 58 samples. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.

signature_version: Signature version: the safety Balance assessor — the chapter's A7 Balance (openness vs control) scored per network segment, with the 'universal safety' framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: baseline for a full business cycle first, set thresholds on validation data, then alert with evidence.
math_note: Detector audit at 95%, p=0.05: 58 samples [verified]; Monitoring tap: 1 Gbps at SNR 20: 4392 Mbps [verified]

requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
